async function save(x) {}
async function isFree(x) {
	return true;
}
async function handleA(x) {}
async function handleB(x) {}
async function sleep(ms) {}
async function loadRows() {
	return [];
}

// CASE switch_braceless_forof expect=fire
async function s1(events) {
	for (const evt of events)
		switch (evt.type) {
			case "a":
				await handleA(evt);
				break;
			default:
				await handleB(evt);
				break;
		}
}

// CASE switch_braced_forof expect=fire
async function s2(events) {
	for (const evt of events) {
		switch (evt.type) {
			case "a":
				await handleA(evt);
				break;
			default:
				await handleB(evt);
				break;
		}
	}
}

// CASE switch_braceless_classic expect=fire
async function s3(events) {
	for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++)
		switch (events[i].type) {
			case "a":
				await handleA(events[i]);
				break;
			default:
				await handleB(events[i]);
		}
}

// CASE switch_braceless_multi expect=fire
async function s4(events) {
	for (let i = 0, n = events.length; i < n; i++)
		switch (events[i].type) {
			case "a":
				await handleA(events[i]);
				break;
		}
}

// CASE switch_braceless_return_only expect=pass
async function s5(events) {
	for (const evt of events)
		switch (evt.type) {
			case "stop":
				return await handleA(evt);
		}
}

// CASE multi_braced_return expect=pass
async function e1(ids) {
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
	}
	return null;
}

// CASE multi_braceless_return expect=pass
async function e2(ids) {
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++)
		if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
	return null;
}

// CASE reverse_braceless_return expect=pass
async function e3(ids) {
	for (let i = ids.length; i--; ) if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
	return null;
}

// CASE multi_init_once expect=pass
async function e4() {
	let total = 0;
	for (let rows = await loadRows(), i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
		total += rows[i];
	}
	return total;
}

// CASE multi_init_object expect=pass
async function e5() {
	let total = 0;
	for (
		let i = 0, rows = await loadRows({ limit: 5, sort: "a;b" });
		i < rows.length;
		i++
	) {
		total += rows[i];
	}
	return total;
}

// CASE multi_body_after_object_init expect=fire
async function e6() {
	for (
		let i = 0, rows = await loadRows({ limit: 5, sort: "a;b" });
		i < rows.length;
		i++
	) {
		await save(rows[i]);
	}
}

// CASE multi_regex_in_body expect=fire
async function e7(names) {
	for (let i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
		const clean = names[i].replace(/'/g, "");
		await save(clean);
	}
}

// CASE multi_template_body expect=fire
async function e8(names) {
	for (let i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(`name: ${names[i]} {`);
	}
}

// CASE multi_braceless_no_semicolon expect=fire
async function e9(ids) {
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) await save(ids[i]);
}

// CASE comment_for_text expect=pass
async function e10() {
	// Same as for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) we call the API
	const rows = await loadRows();
	return rows;
}

// CASE string_for_text expect=pass
async function e11() {
	const code = "for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {";
	const rows = await loadRows();
	return [code, rows, "}"];
}

// CASE braceless_else_break expect=fire
async function e12(ids) {
	for (const id of ids)
		if (id) await save(id);
		else break;
}

// CASE braced_guard_break expect=fire
async function e13(ids) {
	for (const id of ids) {
		if (!id) break;
		await save(id);
	}
}

// CASE braceless_try_catch_return expect=pass
async function e14(urls) {
	for (const url of urls)
		try {
			return await save(url);
		} catch (e) {
			continue;
		}
	return null;
}

// CASE braceless_sleep_sibling expect=fire
async function e15(ids) {
	for (const id of ids)
		if (id) {
			await save(id);
			await sleep(10);
		}
}

// CASE braced_sleep_sibling expect=fire
async function e16(ids) {
	for (const id of ids) {
		if (id) {
			await save(id);
			await sleep(10);
		}
	}
}

// CASE multi_helper_outer expect=fire
async function e17(chunks, mapLimit) {
	for (let i = 0, n = chunks.length; i < n; i++) {
		await mapLimit(chunks[i], 4, save);
	}
}

// CASE multi_callback_only expect=pass
async function e18(ids) {
	const work = [];
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		work.push(async () => {
			await save(ids[i]);
		});
	}
	return work;
}

// CASE empty_cond_multi expect=pass
async function e19(read) {
	for (let i = 0, page; ; i++) {
		page = await read(i);
		if (!page) break;
	}
}
